note: Real eCash testnet headers, fetched over P2P from a Bitcoin ABC 0.34.0 peer. Each window's first 12 headers serve as an SPV chain anchor; every header after them must be accepted. [hash, header] pairs, hash big endian.

asert.note: 1421470 to 1421582: the ASERT anchor (1421481) and the first ASERT blocks; 1421482 and 1421483 are the only testnet blocks whose target clamps to the pow limit.

twentyMinute.note: 1424287 to 1424480: the first blocks mined under the 20 minute rule after ASERT (1424299, 1424355, 1424473).
